verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents background automation directly. Syncs run on a schedule you set, on a trigger, or when data changes, then report each run's outcome, with alerts when a run fails (docs-3, docs-20, docs-49, docs-28). Marketers can also build automated journeys (docs-19), and AI Decisioning 'agents' bundle audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules and guardrails, using reinforcement learning to choose message, channel and timing on their own (docs-46, docs-14). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably unattended, and deeper documentation of how autonomous the AI Decisioning agents are once launched (only summary-level descriptions in the pack).
